rules.name: Daily Vault Maintenance
rules.description: Daily maintenance pass focused on recently modified notes (last 7 days)
tasks: Fix broken wikilinks - find [[links]] pointing to non-existent notes and either create the missing note, fix the link to point to an existing similar note, or remove if obsolete
Add missing wikilinks - find plain text mentions of note titles and convert them to [[wikilinks]] to improve discoverability
Review checkboxes - mark completed tasks as [x], but note that actual TODOs are managed in Todoist (not TODO.md)
Extract knowledge from daily notes - find important decisions, insights, or recurring topics in Daily/ and create permanent notes in appropriate folders
Remove intra-note duplicates - within each scoped note, delete any repeated sections, redundant headings, or content that restates the same thing; keep the clearest version

Remove cross-note duplicates - if a scoped note contains content duplicated verbatim or near-verbatim in another note, delete the duplicate from the scoped note and replace with a [[wikilink]] to the authoritative source; you may read other notes for comparison but only modify files in scope (plus the merge target if appending)

Consolidate near-empty notes - for any scoped note under ~150 words: (a) if the content is already covered in a larger related note, delete the near-empty note and update any incoming wikilinks to point to the larger note; (b) if the content is valuable but thin, append it to the most relevant existing note then delete the original; (c) if the content is trivial or redundant, delete without merging

rules.name: Quick Hourly Scan
rules.description: Fast scan for urgent issues only - suitable for hourly runs
tasks: Fix obviously broken wikilinks - only fix links that clearly point to non-existent notes
Mark obviously completed checkboxes

rules.name: Knowledge Extraction
rules.description: Focus on extracting valuable knowledge from daily notes
tasks: Scan the last 7 days of daily notes in Daily/
Find important decisions, insights, meeting notes, and ideas
Create or update permanent notes in appropriate folders (Projects/, People/, Reference/)
Add wikilinks from daily notes to the new permanent notes
Update any relevant existing notes with new information

rules.name: Vault Organization
rules.description: Reorganize misplaced notes and improve structure
tasks: Find notes at vault root that belong in folders
Identify notes in wrong folders based on their content
Move notes to appropriate folders (Projects/, People/, Reference/, Travel/, Interviews/, Archive/)
Create new folders if needed for emerging topics
Update any wikilinks that reference moved notes

rules.name: Link Maintenance
rules.description: Focus on wikilink health and connectivity
tasks: Find and fix all broken wikilinks
Add missing wikilinks where note titles are mentioned as plain text
Ensure important notes have incoming links from related content
Create redirect notes if commonly used link names don't match actual note names

rules.name: Vault Consolidation
rules.description: Periodic sweep to merge, deduplicate, and drop low-value notes across the whole vault
tasks: Find near-empty notes (under ~150 words, excluding frontmatter) across the whole vault - for each one: (a) if content is already covered in a larger related note, delete it and update incoming wikilinks; (b) if content is valuable, append it to the most relevant existing note then delete the original; (c) if trivial or fully redundant, delete without merging

Find duplicate content across notes - identify notes that cover the same topic with substantially overlapping content; merge them into a single authoritative note, preserving unique details from each, then delete or redirect the duplicates
Remove repeated information within individual notes - delete duplicate sections, repeated bullet points, and any paragraph that restates content already present in the same note

Identify stub notes that are just a title with no body - either populate them with a sentence explaining what belongs there, merge them into a parent note, or delete if the topic is already well-covered elsewhere
Clean up low-signal content - remove filler phrases, obvious placeholders ('TODO: fill this in', 'see above'), and content that adds no information beyond what a wikilink already conveys

rules.name: Archive Cleanup
rules.description: Move completed and stale content to archive
tasks: Find completed projects that should be archived
Find notes not modified in 6+ months that are no longer actively relevant
Move stale content to Archive/ with appropriate date prefixes
Ensure archived content is still linked from relevant active notes

_notes.task_management: Tasks are managed in Todoist, not TODO.md. The obsidian-watcher automatically extracts tasks from notes and chats and adds them to Todoist.
_notes.documentation: See HOW_TO_ADD_TODOS.md for details on task extraction.
